occurrences.text: LOLA: “That’s why I’m over here. Ahmed insisted the little bugger pops out over here.”
LOLA: “Ahmed was more into it than I was. Kept bringing home these fliers, blue for remain, red for leave.”
LOLA: “Ahmed had a few run ins with Brexiteers. You know, the hardline knobs with Union Jack hoodies and Winston Churchill tattoos.”
LOLA: “Wasn’t worth it over there. Ahmed’s jobs had dried up anyway, no-one wanted to hire a foreigner.”
LOLA: “I never told Ahmed that I…”
